स्फिट् vt. 10U (pres. स्फेटयति-ते) 1. To hurt, to injure, to kill; 2. to despise; 3. to love.
स्फिट्ट् vt. 10U (pres. स्फिट्टयति-ते) See स्फिट् above.
स्फिर a. (f. रा; compar. स्फेयस्; super. स्फेष्ठ) 1. Abundant, much, large; 2. vast, capacious.
स्फिर a. (f. रा; compar. स्फेयस्; super. स्फेष्ठ) 1. Abundant, much, large; 2. vast, capacious.
स्फीत a. (f. ता) 1. Swollen, increased, fat, thick, big; 2. much, abundant, many, numerous; 3. successful, prosperous; 4. affected by hereditary disease.(स्फीतीकृ ‘to enlarge, to augment.’)
स्फीत a. (f. ता) 1. Swollen, increased, fat, thick, big; 2. much, abundant, many, numerous; 3. successful, prosperous; 4. affected by hereditary disease.(स्फीतीकृ ‘to enlarge, to augment.’)
स्फीति f. 1. Increase, enlargement; 2. prosperity; 3. abundance, plenty, यन्निंबानां परिणतफलस्फीतिरास्वादनीया K.Pr.x.
